caption: The drawing depicts a footstool with a cushion and wooden rockers. The cushion on top is green and features a leafy or vine-like pattern, transitioning in hues of darker and lighter green. Below the cushion, the structure supporting it is made of reddish-brown wood, shaped into two curved rockers that mirror each other, creating a cradling effect. The overall design looks compact and symmetrical. In the bottom left corner, there is a small inset line drawing showing the same object in a simple elevation view, including a dimension marked "14 1/2". The main image and the inset are enclosed within rectangular borders. There is cursive text in the bottom right corner, and another line of text above it, identifying the object and the artist. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Rocker Footstool
